HADESANCIENTS-VICIOUS_FLOURISH.title: Vicious Flourish
HADESANCIENTS-VICIOUS_FLOURISH.descripti: Whenever you play a Skill card, apply [blue]{WoundsPower}[/blue] [gold]Wounds[/gold] to a random enemy.
HADESANCIENTS-VICIOUS_STRIKE.title: Vicious Strike
HADESANCIENTS-VICIOUS_STRIKE.description: Upon pickup, choose [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attacks in your [gold]Deck[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] them with [purple]Vicious[/purple].
HADESANCIENTS-VISCERAL_IMPACT.title: Visceral Impact
HADESANCIENTS-VISCERAL_IMPACT.descriptio: At the start of each turn, lose [blue]{HpLoss}[/blue] HP. At the end of your first turn, your Form card is played for free.
